title: The Proposal of the Ultimate Chess Player
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji fell into deep contemplation, he suddenly realized that the choice framework given by Cang Yutian itself was a sealing formation operating at the cost of his Heavenly Fate Value.

text.content: In the dark Void, Cang Yutian's figure stood like an ancient sculpture, with billions of intertwined Threads of Fate flowing around him. Each thread connected to the joys, sorrows, glories and humiliations of countless beings. His face was hidden behind light and shadow, only those deep, unfathomable eyes revealed a cold indifference that had seen through worldly affairs.

dialogue.content: A millennium. I have waited for you at this intersection of fate for a thousand years, Chen Ji.

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, the Tianji Record Fragment faintly glowing behind him, but without activating its Foresight Ability. He knew that here, any attempt to peer into the future was futile. Cang Yutian's very existence was an impassable dam in the river of destiny.

dialogue.content: The Tianji Record in your hands is merely one of the fragments I lost in the mortal realm. It allows you to glimpse three hours ahead, yet simultaneously implants the shackles of Heavenly Fate within you. Each act of foresight is essentially paying a toll to me.

text.content: A subtle shift flickered in Chen Ji's eyes, though his heart remained crystal clear: Cang Yutian was forcing him to reveal his hand. But Chen Ji never fought unprepared battles. Long before entering this Void, he had already calculated 13,726 possible scenarios within his Mental Sea.

dialogue.content: Three paths diverge. The first: break through Heaven's shackles, transcend fate, become a true free being—the cost is all your current bonds, including those you cherish. The second: replace me, become the new Chess Player, inherit Heaven's authority and responsibility—the cost is you will be forever trapped on this chessboard. The third: mutual annihilation with me, return Heaven and Earth to chaos—the cost is this realm perishes alongside you.

text.content: Upon hearing this, an inexplicable smile curved at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. In Cang Yutian's eyes, this smile was like watching an ant who knew of the trap yet still dared to probe—ant confidence is always the most interesting embellishment.

dialogue.content: The three paths the Senior mentions are indeed masterful. However, there is one thing this junior cannot comprehend—why are all three paths related to the 'Axis of Fate'?

text.content: The Void trembled microscopically, and for the first time, a ripple appeared in Cang Yutian's gaze. The Axis of Fate—this was a forbidden concept even Heaven's Will had never touched, the most core secret of this realm. He never expected Chen Ji to have glimpsed this term from the incomplete Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: You are more perceptive than I anticipated. Indeed, all three paths require the power of the Axis of Fate to realize. The Axis of Fate is the foundation supporting this realm; controlling it allows one to rewrite all cause and effect.

text.content: From the distant direction of the Tianqing Sect, a thunderous roar suddenly erupted. A profound, meaningful smile played at the corner of Cang Yutian's lips.

dialogue.content: The imperial forces have already made their move. Your junior sister Su Qingyao is buying you time with her life. How long will you hesitate here?

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Su Qingyao—that woman who had repeatedly nearly exposed his disguise, yet ultimately chose to protect him—now stood between him and the empire's destructive might. He could sense her Heavenly Fate Value burning at an alarming rate.

dialogue.content: This is the weight of choice, Chen Ji. Those you cherish are paying the price for you. You have only three hundred breaths to decide.

choice.prompt: Within three hundred breaths, as Su Qingyao's Heavenly Fate Value continuously depleted, Chen Ji had to make his choice within Cang Yutian's framework.

choices.description: Choose to become a free being, transcending fate, at the cost of abandoning all bonds.
choices.visible_cost: Lose Su Qingyao and all those you cherish
choices.risk_hint: Extremely dangerous, may lose all emotional anchors

text.content: Cang Yutian nodded subtly, tracing a cryptic symbol in the Void. "Since you have made your choice—"

choices.description: Do not accept the cost of bond severance, demand preservation of some emotional connections.
choices.visible_cost: Negotiation takes time, Su Qingyao's situation grows more dangerous
choices.visible_reward: May secure conditions to preserve key bonds
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may tighten the conditions

text.content: A glint of amusement crossed Cang Yutian's eyes: "Interesting, you actually want to bargain with me?"

choices.text: Carve your own path, refuse the framework
choices.description: Do not accept any path given by Cang Yutian, create a third possibility yourself.
choices.visible_cost: Enrage Cang Yutian, the situation becomes more perilous
choices.visible_reward: Break conventional thinking, may discover a hidden fourth path
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, but massive gains if successful

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly let out a soft laugh: "The three paths the Senior offers are indeed masterful, but—why must one choose within your framework?"

dialogue.content: "Presumptuous! For a millennium, no one has dared question the paths I offer!"

text.content: The Void violently quaked as countless fate threads surged toward Chen Ji, each carrying enough karmic force to crush a Golden Core cultivator. Yet Chen Ji merely stood calmly in place, allowing those threads to wrap around him—only to watch them shatter to pieces upon contact.

dialogue.content: Because the Senior forgot one thing—the Tianji Record is a fragment you lost, and every crack on that fragment is a direction for my repair.

text.content: Cang Yutian's expression froze for the first time. He lowered his gaze to the fate threads surrounding him—those millions of threads he took pride in now had a third beginning to shake uncontrollably, as if responding to a summons from a higher dimension.

dialogue.content: "You... what did you implant within the Tianji Record?!"

text.content: Chen Ji offered no answer. His gaze pierced through the Void, toward the Tianqing Sect—Su Qingyao's figure was locked in fierce combat with the imperial emissaries, her sword light already dyed with the golden-crimson hue of burning Heavenly Fate. He had to conclude this dialogue quickly.

dialogue.content: The Senior offered this junior three paths, yet this junior only wishes to ask one question—outside these three paths, is there a fourth? A path that requires no choice, no cost, no becoming anyone's chess piece?

text.content: Silence. Endless silence. Within the Void, only the faint sounds of shattered fate threads remained, like the funeral bells of doom. When Cang Yutian spoke again, his voice carried an imperceptible trace of... wariness.

dialogue.content: A millennium has passed. Finally, someone asks this question. Chen Ji, you are more dangerous than I anticipated—and far more interesting.

text.content: At this very moment, Chen Ji suddenly sensed the anomaly. The fate threads around Cang Yutian were not shattering—they were—reorganizing. Those threads were weaving according to a trajectory he had never witnessed, ultimately converging into a massive formation rune covering the entire Void. And he stood precisely at the center of this formation.

So that's how it is. Cang Yutian's 'choices' themselves constituted a trap. No matter which path he chose, he would unknowingly inject Heavenly Fate Value into this formation—and this formation's ultimate destination was the Axis of Fate. Chen Ji calculated rapidly within his Mental Sea, and his expression finally changed—the moment he chose the framework, he had already paid the 'admission fee' to the Axis of Fate.

Yet Chen Ji's smile grew even deeper. He had waited for this moment, waited far too long. After scheming across the world for so many years, he had long grown accustomed to embedding his own chess pieces within others' traps—and now, he had finally found this rare, once-in-a-millennium opportunity.
"Senior, you thought this junior was questioning your framework? No, this junior is merely confirming—where are the 'loopholes' in your framework? After all, every formation has flaws, does it not?"
